meta.title: A saved eRFX draft: "Items 1" opens the "Manage Line Items" window
gaps: The catalog cannot directly assert that no event data changes until Save or another drawer action is pressed.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The catalog cannot directly assert that no event data changes until Save or another drawer action is pressed.

steps.note: Start an eRFX create flow so the test can produce the required saved draft.
Provide the mandatory title needed to save the draft.
Apply a pricing template before adding the line item.
Create the single line item required for the Items 1 control.
Complete the pricing sheet so the draft can be saved consistently.
Persist the eRFX event as an unpublished draft.
Navigate to the events list to reopen the saved draft.
Show the saved draft in the Drafts tab.
Verify that the plan's draft is present before opening it.
Open the saved draft's create screen from the Drafts list.
Open the line-item management window from the saved draft.
Verify that the expected line-item management window opened.
Verify that the drawer exposes the Quantity control.
Verify that the expected Variant 1 control is present.
Verify that the drawer offers Cancel.
Verify that the drawer offers Save without pressing it.
